title: Blood Red Lotus
art_style: High-contrast, chiaroscuro noir; moody lighting with blood-red accents
short_summary: In rain-soaked 1950s New Harbor, ex-cop Jack Malone investigates the murder of Eddie Chen, uncovering betrayal, mob ties, and police corruption. Haunted by loss and the city's darkness, Jack seeks justice and redemption amid neon and shadows.
world_context: New Harbor City, 1950s—fog-choked streets, neon-lit clubs, and rain-slick tenements. A city where justice is rumor, and loyalty, currency. Police and mob are entwined, and survival means compromise. Technology is analog; evidence is as easily forged as trust. In the city’s jazz-fueled underbelly, one murder will ripple through the web of corruption—if anyone can follow the scent of blood through the rain.

characters.name: Jack Malone
characters.physical_traits: Rugged, weathered face, sharp blue eyes, limp in left leg, short dark hair with gray at temples, stubble beard
quirks: Always rubs a silver dollar for luck
characters.typical_attire: Dark trenchcoat, fedora, loose tie, scuffed shoes
characters.backstory: Ex-cop forced out after a scandal, now a private detective. Haunted by guilt over past cases and the city’s corruption.
characters.motivations: Driven by justice and loyalty to the lost, especially those who have no one else. Seeks redemption for his own failures.

characters.name: Veronica Steele
characters.physical_traits: Tall, lithe, pale skin, black hair in 1950s waves, emerald green eyes, red lipstick
characters.typical_attire: Silk evening dress, green gloves, pearl earrings, high heels
characters.backstory: Owner of the Black Lotus Club, survivor of a hard upbringing, fiercely protective of her brother Eddie.
characters.motivations: Desperate to protect her brother and her club, torn between survival and doing what’s right.

characters.name: Eddie Chen
characters.physical_traits: Slim, youthful, nervous energy, black hair, brown eyes, quick smile
characters.typical_attire: Work shirt, suspenders, worn jeans, old baseball cap
characters.backstory: Veronica’s younger brother, informant for Jack, caught between criminal factions.
characters.motivations: Wanted to escape the city’s grip and protect his sister, but got in too deep.

characters.name: Tommy “The Knife” Russo
characters.physical_traits: Broad-shouldered, cold gray eyes, slicked-back dark hair, scar on right cheek
characters.typical_attire: Pinstripe suit, black leather gloves, silk tie, polished shoes
characters.backstory: Mob enforcer, loyal to the family but haunted by guilt over past violence.
characters.motivations: Bound by loyalty and survival, but cracks under pressure and guilt.

characters.name: Captain Morrison
characters.physical_traits: Heavyset, graying hair, pockmarked face, piercing hazel eyes
characters.typical_attire: Police uniform or rumpled suit, badge always visible
characters.backstory: Corrupt police captain, manipulates evidence and alliances to maintain power.
characters.motivations: Self-preservation and maintaining control over his precinct and the city’s criminal underbelly.

chapters.chapter_summary: The Black Lotus Club closes. Veronica disappears. At dawn, Jack visits Eddie’s grave, leaves a silver dollar, and reflects on scars and fleeting hope. The city’s wounds remain, but for a moment, the air feels almost clean.

scenes.scene_description: The Black Lotus Club closes for the last time. Neon sign flickers out. Veronica slips away into the night.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in high-contrast chiaroscuro noir. Establishing shot of the Black Lotus Club at night, neon sign flickering red above the rain-slicked street. The club's doors are closing, casting long shadows onto the wet pavement. The city glows faintly in the background, fog swirling around the streetlights. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: The club closes for the last time, neon sign flickers out.

dialogue.text: The Black Lotus Club closed its doors. Neon faded into the rain.

panels.color_palette: deep blacks, blood-red neon, muted grays

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in high-contrast noir. Medium shot of Veronica Steele in a silk dress and green gloves, slipping away from the club’s side door into the misty night. Her face is half-lit by the dying neon, expression unreadable. The street is empty, rain glistening on the cobblestones. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Veronica leaves the club, vanishing into the night.

important_objects.label: woman in silk dress and gloves

pages.page_description: The Black Lotus Club closes for good; Veronica disappears into the rain.

scenes.scene_description: Jack visits Eddie’s grave at dawn. The city’s rain has washed away the worst stains, but the scars remain.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in chiaroscuro noir. Establishing shot of a rain-soaked cemetery at dawn, rows of gravestones glistening under gray light. Mist drifts between the stones, and the city skyline is barely visible beyond the iron gates. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Establishes the cemetery at dawn, rain still falling.

dialogue.text: Gray dawn. The city’s rain had washed away the worst stains.

panels.color_palette: muted grays, pale blue, hints of red

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Medium shot of Jack Malone in trenchcoat and fedora, standing before Eddie’s grave. He holds a silver dollar in his hand, head bowed. The gravestone is simple, rain streaking its surface. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack stands at Eddie’s grave, preparing to leave the silver dollar.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Close-up of Jack’s gloved hand placing a silver dollar on the wet gravestone. Raindrops bead on the coin and stone. The background is blurred, focusing on the gesture. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack places the silver dollar on Eddie’s grave.

pages.page_description: Jack visits Eddie’s grave at dawn, leaves a silver dollar.

scenes.scene_description: Jack limps away from the grave, trenchcoat flapping, notebook in hand. The city’s wounds remain.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Medium shot, low angle, of Jack limping away from the grave along a gravel path. His trenchcoat flaps in the morning breeze, and his limp is pronounced. The city skyline looms in the misty distance. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack limps away from the grave, trenchcoat flapping.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Close-up of Jack’s battered notebook in his hand, rain speckling the cover. The pages are filled with scribbled case notes, and a faint blood-red reflection from the city glows on the wet surface. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack’s hand grips his notebook, hinting at more cases to come.

dialogue.text: Still more cases waited. The city’s wounds never fully healed.

pages.page_description: Jack limps away from the grave, notebook in hand, city looming.

scenes.scene_description: For a brief moment, in the hush before sunrise, the air feels almost clean.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Wide shot of the cemetery bathed in the first golden light of sunrise. Mist lifts from the grass, and the city skyline is touched with pale warmth. Jack’s silhouette is small in the distance, walking away. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: The city and cemetery at sunrise, Jack walking away.

dialogue.text: For one brief moment, the air felt almost clean.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in noir style. Close-up of sunlight breaking through mist, illuminating a single raindrop on a blade of grass. The city’s reflection is faint in the droplet. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Sunrise light and a raindrop symbolize fleeting hope.

pages.page_description: Sunrise brings a fleeting sense of peace and hope.
